rationale: Tried horizontal-flip data augmentation (effective 2x dataset) with epochs halved 8->4 to keep total step count constant. Val 0.6445 -> 0.6418 (-0.4%), within noise. advice_for_others: On synthetic ellipse phantoms at 128 sparse views, doubling data via horizontal flip at fixed total compute does not improve SSIM measurably. Next: try capacity (c=24).
